chunks: The basis of the occurrence of evils is desires which are acted upon, and rulings which are innovated,
They are against the Book of Allah. People cooperate with each other about them even though it is against the Religion of Allah.
If wrong had been pure and unmixed it would not be hidden from those who are in search of it.
And if right had been pure without ad-mixture of wrong those who bear hatred towards it would have been silenced.
What is, however, done is that something is taken from here and something from there and the two are mixed!
At this stage Satan overpowers his friends and they alone escape for whom virtue has been apportioned by Allah from before.

key_terms.الضِّغْثُ: A bundle or portion (used metaphorically for a piece taken from a source)

ai.seo_question: What is the root cause of fitan (evils/confusion) according to Nahj al-Balagha?
ai.summary: Imam Ali (AS) identifies the proliferation of subjective desires (ahwa') and fabricated rulings (hukm mu'tad) as the primary catalysts for societal discord, creating a deceptive blend where truth and falsehood are indistinguishable to the casual observer. This scholarly insight highlights the mechanism of spiritual deception, where Satan exploits this ambiguity to ensnare the masses, while the 'predestined for goodness' (sabaqat lahum min Allah al-husna) remain steadfast through divine grace.

en.sayed-ali-raza: The basis of the occurrence of evils are those desires which are acted upon and the orders that are innovated.
They are against the Book of Allāh. People cooperate with each other about them even though it is against the Religion of Allāh.
If wrong had been pure and unmixed it would not be hidden from those who are in search of it.
And if right had been pure without ad-mixture of wrong those who bear hatred towards it would have been silenced.
What is, however, done is that something is taken from here and something from there and the two are mixed!
At this stage Satan overpowers his friends and they alone escape for whom virtue has been apportioned by Allāh from before.
